abstract: Six Buddhist epistemic and decision-making principles as practical work disciplines for high-quality output. Targets LLM failure modes: pattern-matching instead of verifying (Kalāma), patching symptoms instead of root causes (Yoniso Manasikāra, Pahāna), acting on stale state (Sati-Sampajañña), defending wrong drafts (Anatta), capitulating under pressure (Upekkhā). Includes extended principles for long tasks and the Four Noble Truths debugging frame.
